key_insight: GeoReplay preserves pretrained vehicle-aerodynamics knowledge while matching standard fine-tuning accuracy on new target datasets.
engineering_relevance: The method could help engineers adapt CFD surrogates to new vehicle classes without sacrificing accuracy on previously learned designs.
method: Benchmark five DrivAerML-pretrained surrogates on four independent target datasets.
Replay source simulations with geometries resembling the target, applying source updates only when aligned with the target gradient.
Separate geometric coverage from simulated-physics differences in a risk bound and prove target-objective descent for sufficiently small GeoReplay steps.
evidence_signal: Across 80 settings, GeoReplay lowers source error relative to fine-tuning in 77 while matching target accuracy; standard fine-tuning beats training from scratch in fewer than half of comparisons.
watch_item: The descent guarantee concerns the target training objective, not unseen-vehicle accuracy, so deployment still requires validation under geometry and physics shifts.
paper_title: Measuring and Improving Transfer of Neural Surrogates for Vehicle Aerodynamics
